# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.x | Yes |
| Earlier versions | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lucasgmagalhaes/AudioNormalizer/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for a potential security problem.

Include, where possible:

- A clear description of the impact.
- Steps or a minimal file that reproduces the issue.
- Affected version, operating system, and FFmpeg version.
- Any suggested mitigation or fix.

We aim to acknowledge reports within five business days and will provide status updates while investigating. Please allow time for a fix to be released before publicly disclosing the issue.

## Scope

Reports are in scope when they affect Audio Normalizer's Rust engine, native FFmpeg bridge, desktop UI, build configuration, or bundled runtime files. Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies are in scope when they can be exploited through this application or its packaging.

## Safe harbor

Good-faith research that avoids privacy violations, data loss, service disruption, and access to data that does not belong to you is welcome. We will not pursue legal action for research that follows this policy.
